label: Rule 110 parity-G closure
title: Groovy closes Rule 110 parity readout but not its own augmented state
summary: For Rule 110, current parity plus centered Groovy determines the next parity bit by an exact cubic radius-one law, but two bi-infinite configurations have identical entire current parity+Groovy fields and different next Groovy. The augmented state is not autonomous.
takeaway: Groovy is a sufficient readout correction for parity, not a closed history state; the missing distinction is exposed by a blockwise complement phase-domain-wall witness.
